race.description: Nutrien Equine Nsw Breeders Challenge 2yo C&G Heat - Round 2
race.comment: OH ITS ON (9) came from this barrier and chased a smart one when runner-up in a heat of this series here last start. Easily won his previous two outings including the Tatlow Stakes at this circuit and distance when he led from this barrier. The one to beat. REVVIN REYNARD (6) had enough speed to find the lead from this barrier before fighting well to go under narrowly last start at Newcastle. He should be further improved third-up. ROGUE BANDIT (12) cops the outside barrier but showed good improvement to place here last time and won his only previous third-up attempt. PRETTY PRIVILEGE (8) has decent form away from the city, winning twice in a row before a second in a heat of this series at Newcastle last time out.
